transcript_full_pass: Planning a meetup, but one friend isn't on WhatsApp. On November 5, WhatsApp updated events. Create an event, add a photo, and share one link with everyone. Your friend opens it and can RSVP without downloading the app. Replies land in the new event's home with reminders. One limit, guests without WhatsApp see the address only after replying. It's rolling out to everyone over the coming weeks. Follow Media Diet for technology explained. You
